production_fixture_contract.counterexample: A real alive hostile, same-map, same-instance target is closer than the selected ResolvedCombatAction.MinRange. The real validation update submits world.profile_combat_range, the typed arbiter commits its Movement-only lane, the existing range mover selects an outward logical destination, and native movement progresses before an ordinary cast is retried.
production_fixture_contract.compiled_boundary: The compiled fixture must call the shared production candidate adapter used by SubmitValidationKernelFallbackCandidates; it must not construct a replacement world.profile_combat_range candidate or duplicate its admission branches.
production_fixture_contract.worldserver_boundary: A subsequent separately authorized observation-only worldserver replay must enter through UpdateBot and the actual SubmitValidationKernelFallbackCandidates call, invoke the real ResolveProfileCombatAction callback, resolve the real DecisionKernel, invoke the unchanged MoveBotToProfileRange and MoveBotToPoint path, retain a movement receipt plus live generator/spline identity, sample decreasing distance over at least two later ticks, and join a later ordinary cast attempt to the same actor and target.
required_positive: the candidate key is world.profile_combat_range and its sole resource is Movement
a live valid too-close target reaches the existing range mover
the manager-owned candidate, arbiter trace, movement receipt, generator/spline, progress samples, and later cast share explicit correlation keys
a real higher-priority Hazard Movement candidate wins the same arbiter tick and the production range candidate is skipped for Movement conflict rather than attempted
after observed hazard or range progress, a later ordinary cast retry remains eligible because the movement candidate never claims GCD, Cast, Target, or Interaction
required_negatives: valid target already inside the legal action band
production_fixture_contract.actual_hazard_requirement: The production-boundary receipt must use a candidate emitted by the existing hazard producer. A hand-written Hazard or range replacement candidate cannot satisfy this condition.
production_fixture_contract.fail_before: The current retained tests can pass without a production manager submission, native receipt, generator/spline progress, or later cast.
production_fixture_contract.pass_after_implementation: The production adapter and default-off checkpoint exist at one clean reviewed identity, compiled value-level positives/negatives pass through the shared adapter, and no gameplay predicate beyond commit 7444666b changes.
production_fixture_contract.pass_after_worldserver_replay: A later separately authorized replay supplies the manager-to-native positive and actual-Hazard receipts. Only then may an independent reviewer call the fixture fixture-green.
